vuln_statements.explanation: This loop iterates based on firmware-provided num_ifs value without validation against DPSW_MAX_IF, allowing out-of-bounds access to cfg->if_id array when num_ifs exceeds the array size
This write operation stores data into cfg->if_id array using index i derived from unvalidated num_ifs, causing buffer overflow when num_ifs > DPSW_MAX_IF
